nodes.label: cfg.cssEntry (compiled root-*.css)
nodes.rationale: app/app.css is Tailwind v4 source and cannot ship raw, so cssEntry points at the app build's compiled stylesheet; the filename is content-hashed and must be updated after every yarn build (re-sync risk, L45).

nodes.label: npm install/dev/build instructions
nodes.rationale: Stale template text: the project uses yarn and commits only yarn.lock.

nodes.norm_label: compiled css only contains used utilities

nodes.label: CRLF vs Prettier endOfLine on Windows
nodes.norm_label: crlf vs prettier endofline on windows
nodes.rationale: core.autocrlf=true writes CRLF while .prettierrc sets lf; check with --end-of-line auto and never run yarn format to clear it, since that rewrites every file's line endings.

nodes.label: Dockerfile npm ci / missing package-lock.json
nodes.rationale: Only yarn.lock is committed, so the Dockerfile's npm ci fails until fixed.

nodes.label: InvoiceStoreContext / InvoiceStoreKey
nodes.rationale: Carries {kind, mode} so shared cards edit the right store; importing a store directly into a shared card would make the editor view edit the draft.

nodes.label: Prop-less page-level components
nodes.rationale: CustomerForm, InvoiceBody, SettingsSidebar, WareHouseAssets read app state and take no props, so new screens should compose ui primitives instead.

nodes.label: Draft and editor invoice store instances
nodes.norm_label: draft and editor invoice store instances
nodes.rationale: Each kind's store factory is instantiated twice: useInvoiceStore/useBlockInvoiceStore drafts for creation and stoneInvoiceEditor/blockInvoiceEditor for saved invoices.

nodes.label: gen-types.mjs prop-contract generator
nodes.rationale: With no library .d.ts tree every contract was an [key: string]: unknown stub; the script emits declarations into .design-sync/.cache/types plus an index.d.ts barrel, dropping stubs from 217 to 36. Must run after yarn build and before the converter, or contracts silently revert to stubs.

nodes.label: componentSrcMap pins
nodes.rationale: The converter matches components to source files by file name; repeated names (Table.tsx, InfoBox.tsx, Signature.tsx) and kebab-case shadcn files need explicit pins. data-table/ uses prefixed names so it needs none.

nodes.label: dtsPropsFor overrides for shadcn wrappers
nodes.rationale: FieldLabel, SidebarInput, SidebarSeparator, SidebarTrigger take all props from another component, which the extractor drops; SidebarInput deliberately has no children. The other 32 stubs are genuinely prop-less store-driven components.

nodes.label: Folder-qualified exports for colliding names
nodes.rationale: AppHeader, InvoiceTableRow, RequestLower/UpperTable*, SettingsInvoiceSection, ReceiptIssueInvoiceSection, DeliveryAdditionalNote, SalesAdditionalNote; bare names are excluded with componentSrcMap: null.

nodes.label: Do not set cfg.tsconfig
nodes.rationale: The converter's tsconfigPathsPlugin tries the bare path before /index.tsx, so directory imports like ~/components/invoice fail in esbuild; esbuild's built-in tsconfig resolution handles ~/ correctly, and bundle.mjs must not be forked, so config is the fix.

nodes.label: No converter lib forks rule
nodes.rationale: Any non-null componentSrcMap pin made source-kit.mjs skip derivation, collapsing 209 components to 22; the fix is the gen-types barrel providing the export list, not a fork. If pins collapse the count, check that gen-types.mjs ran.

nodes.label: Sliced Zustand stores
nodes.rationale: Each sections/*.ts StateCreator is spread into one create() with an intersection type in types.ts; used by useSettingStore and useWarehouse.

nodes.label: Append-only stock movements (کاردکس)
nodes.rationale: Modelled on the future database table: item quantity is a cached balance, every change appends movements in the same set(), and movements are never edited or deleted.

nodes.label: No backend: in-memory Zustand only
nodes.rationale: No loaders, actions or persistence yet, so a reload loses everything; stones.json seeds the main warehouse.

nodes.label: .design-sync/default-exports.ts re-export module
nodes.rationale: The synth entry's export * skips every default export (79 component files) and silently drops named exports defined in two files (AdditionalNote); the first validate failed [BUNDLE_EXPORT] with 70/209 components missing. New default-exported components must get a line here.

nodes.label: /design-login upload authorization
nodes.rationale: DesignSync had no authorization on the first sync and /design-login cannot run non-interactively; no projectId is pinned yet.

nodes.label: ds-bundle EPERM on Windows
nodes.rationale: package-build.mjs cannot delete ds-bundle/ while a shell sits inside it; always use absolute paths and keep shells at the repo root.

nodes.label: --entry ./dist/index.js flag
nodes.rationale: A non-existent entry path makes the walk-up find the repo package.json (PKG_DIR = repo root) and fall back to synthesizing from cfg.srcDir; without it the converter looks for node_modules/rock-fact and crashes.

nodes.label: Synth-entry mode (bundle from app/components)
nodes.rationale: The repo is a private React Router app with no library dist/, so the converter synthesizes its entry from cfg.srcDir; prop contracts come from source and are weaker than a library build.

nodes.label: Embedded base64 PNG raster (1174x1254 RGBA)
nodes.rationale: The .svg is only a 1254x1254 wrapper around a single <image> element holding a ~1.2MB base64 PNG, so the file is ~1.5MB and is not a true scalable vector; it is imported by the Header component as the app logo.

nodes.label: Modern Stone Logo (Rock Fact brand mark)
nodes.norm_label: modern stone logo (rock fact brand mark)

nodes.label: Gold/bronze swoosh accent
nodes.rationale: Gold/bronze accent on black and beige matches the app theme's warm-remapped slate/gray tones and gold brand-* scale.

nodes.label: Warehouse with shelved stone blocks motif
nodes.norm_label: warehouse with shelved stone blocks motif

nodes.label: Preview story format
nodes.rationale: One export const per story with shared sample data above the first export (prompt examples are cut between exports); every Persian preview wraps content in dir=rtl; Table uses cardMode column, Dialog cardMode single at 720x520.

nodes.label: Sales invoice locking (isLocked)
nodes.rationale: A sales invoice is locked after saving; only pre-invoices can be edited.

nodes.label: Samim body font and font-vazirmatn for print
nodes.norm_label: samim body font and font-vazirmatn for print

nodes.label: cfg.extraFonts (Samim, Vazirmatn)
nodes.rationale: Vite's compiled CSS references fonts by root-absolute /assets URLs the converter cannot map; samim-font and @fontsource-variable/vazirmatn source stylesheets use relative URLs and ship correctly.

nodes.label: Samim body font, font-vazirmatn for print
nodes.norm_label: samim body font, font-vazirmatn for print

nodes.label: Inter removed from --font-sans
nodes.rationale: The theme named Inter first but the app never loaded it, so validate flagged [FONT_MISSING]; the user chose to remove it rather than ship Inter or accept the warning.

nodes.label: graphify skill (/graphify trigger)
nodes.rationale: Installed at .claude/skills/graphify/SKILL.md; when the user types /graphify, the skill must be used before doing anything else.

nodes.label: *.client.tsx with React.lazy for browser-only code
nodes.rationale: SSR is on, so browser-only libraries must be isolated in client files and lazy-loaded.

nodes.label: alphaAgent custom agent
nodes.rationale: Unfilled template: description and body are placeholders; tools restricted to Read, Grep, Glob, Bash.

nodes.label: babel-plugin-react-compiler
nodes.rationale: Makes manual memo/useMemo mostly unnecessary; code must follow the Rules of React or the compiler skips it.
